summary: Enhance your leadership skills with our Emotional Intelligence Training Course. Learn to connect, inspire, and lead with empathy for lasting impact.
lede: Emotionally intelligent leadership applies self-awareness, self-regulation, empathy and relationship skills to workplace challenges. For managers, team leaders and professionals who manage people or influence stakeholders, the course addresses leading teams through pressure and change. Participants practice recognizing emotional triggers, regulating stress, understanding team needs, resolving conflict and using coaching conversations to support performance.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who must manage people, influence stakeholders, and maintain team cohesion in high-pressure environments.
modules: Foundations of Emotional Intelligence and Leadership
Social Awareness and Empathy in Teams
prerequisites: Participants should hold a current management or supervisory role, or be identified for a leadership transition. Familiarity with basic performance management processes is recommended. No prior psychological training is required.
